nary_nodes.label: Rising type 2 diabetes in young women
evidence: More and more, younger people are being diagnosed with type 2 diabetes.
In England, for example, the biggest increase in new diagnoses of type 2 diabetes is among young women.

nary_nodes.type_justification: No schema.org event fits rising disease prevalence; minting a new type.

nary_nodes.label: Imperial College study on diabetes trends
evidence: This was revealed when a team of researchers from Imperial College London evaluated data from an English National Diabetes Audit between 2011 and 2024.
nary_nodes.type_definition: An event of conducting a research study.
nary_nodes.type_justification: No schema.org event fits a research study; minting a new type.

nary_nodes.label: Publication in Lancet journal
evidence: The results, published in The Lancet Regional Health Europe journal, showed the sharpest increase was among white, Asian and Black women in their 20s, and white women in their 30s.
nary_nodes.type_justification: Publication in Lancet journal is a publication event.

nary_nodes.label: Rising type 2 diabetes in German youth
evidence: From 2014 to 2023, there was an increase in type 2 diabetes cases of 5.8% a year among youth aged 11 to 17 years, according to a 2026 health report on diabetes released by the DDG.
nary_nodes.type_definition: An event where the prevalence of a disease increases in a population.
nary_nodes.type_justification: No schema.org event fits rising disease prevalence; minting a new type.

nary_nodes.label: DDG calls for VAT reform
evidence: The DDG is calling for a tiered value-added tax (VAT) system, with fresh fruit and vegetables being sold with no tax and the VAT increasing the more the products contain saturated fats and sugars.
nary_nodes.type_definition: An event of proposing a policy or reform.
nary_nodes.type_justification: No schema.org event fits policy proposals; minting a new type.

nary_nodes.label: DDG calls for school health measures
evidence: The organization also wants healthier food in kindergarten and school cafeterias and one hour of mandatory movement per day to be incorporated into class schedules.
nary_nodes.type_definition: An event of proposing a policy or reform.
nary_nodes.type_justification: No schema.org event fits policy proposals; minting a new type.

nary_nodes.label: Report on underdiagnosis in women
evidence: In 2025, Kautzky-Willer and a colleague wrote a report for the Deutsches Ärzteblatt, a German medical journal, saying that the disease is underdiagnosed in women.
nary_nodes.type_justification: Report on underdiagnosis is a publication event.

nary_nodes.label: Diagnosis of type 2 diabetes in women
evidence: At the point of diagnosis, more women are obese, they have hypertension more often and have gained more weight" than men when they are diagnosed.

nary_nodes.type_justification: No schema.org event fits diagnosis; minting a new type.

nary_nodes.type_justification: No schema.org event fits medical tests; minting a new type.

nary_nodes.type_justification: No schema.org event fits medical tests; minting a new type.

evidence: The glucose tolerance and the HbA1c tests are not covered by health insurance in Germany and Austria, only the fasting blood sugar one is covered, and that may be influencing the options for people in those countries.

nary_nodes.type_justification: No schema.org event fits insurance coverage; minting a new type.

nary_nodes.label: Pre-diabetic intervention
evidence: People who find out they have a problem at this early stage still have a chance to turn the ship around.

With lifestyle and nutrition changes, diabetes progression can be stopped in some cases, saving them from a host of health problems later on, which may require regular medication and lead to a reduced life expectancy.

nary_nodes.type_justification: No schema.org event fits prevention; minting a new type.

nary_nodes.label: Misra: diabetes challenge broadening
evidence: "While these ethnic groups are disproportionately affected with early-onset type 2 diabetes, we now see that incidence is […] increasing in white populations too, showing that this public health challenge is broadening across the generation."

nary_nodes.label: Gallwitz: diabetes is a pandemic
evidence: "Type 2 diabetes is on the rise in many countries," Gallwitz told DW.
"It's basically a pandemic."

nary_nodes.label: Gallwitz: lifestyle drives diabetes
evidence: "We live in a world where we don't move enough and where our nutrition contains too much sugar and too many calories," Gallwitz said.
"That leads to more obesity among young people, and that in turn greatly increases the risk of type 2 diabetes."

nary_nodes.label: Kirrane: diabetes serious in young
evidence: "Any diagnosis of type 2 diabetes is serious, but it can be more aggressive in younger people, increasing the risk of devastating complications and cutting lives short," said Helen Kirrane from Diabetes UK, a charity that campaigns on the issue.

nary_nodes.label: Kautzky-Willer: need safe movement
evidence: "More movement is important, so we need to ensure conditions in which it's safe for women to move," Kautzky-Willer, who is also a professor of gender medicine, told DW.

nary_nodes.label: Kautzky-Willer: women underdiagnosed
evidence: "Men are usually diagnosed with [type 2 diabetes] at a younger age," they wrote in the the article.
"At the point of diagnosis, more women are obese, they have hypertension more often and have gained more weight" than men when they are diagnosed.

nary_nodes.label: Kautzky-Willer: fasting sugar lower in women
evidence: Fasting blood sugar "is generally lower in women than it is in men," Kautzky-Willer said.

nary_nodes.label: Kautzky-Willer: glucose test better
evidence: "It would make more sense to do a glucose tolerance test, but that is more work."

nary_nodes.label: Kautzky-Willer: HbA1c test useful
evidence: Kautzky-Willer says it would be good if HbA1c levels were tested as well.

nary_nodes.label: Gallwitz: DDG welcomes soda tax
evidence: Gallwitz said the DDG welcomed the introduction of a tax on sugary sodas in Germany, but added that it wasn't enough.
